books.title: Becoming Aware: A 21-Day Mindfulness Program for Reducing Anxiety and Cultivating Calm
books.author: Daniel J. Siegel
books.description: A three-week workbook that walks readers through the Wheel of Awareness practice from his earlier book Aware, one day at a time. Each day pairs guided meditation with short exercises in focusing attention, opening awareness and building kind intention.

left_out: Personality & Wholeness in Therapy, The Developing Mind, The Mindful Therapist, Pocket Guide to Interpersonal Neurobiology: left out as clinician books (scope), not for health reasons; not reopened.
Innovations in Psychotherapy 2026 (10-13 Nov 2026): starts before 16 Nov 2026; The Mindful Therapist (8 Dec 2026): professional therapy event (scope rule), not a health exclusion; not restored.

Mindsight Institute 'Transforming Anxiety & Stress by Integrating the Embodied Brain' ($449.00, https://mindsightinstitute.com/sales/msi_c_002131_transforminganxiety_organic-1254399/): a continuing-education course for mental-health practitioners that teaches the Wheel of Awareness 'for the treatment of Anxiety'; clinical training (scope rule) with treatment framing, so still out. The other Mindsight courses are clinician CE (scope).
flags: Book: ISBN-10 0143111817 from the Amazon link on his own page https://drdansiegel.com/book/becoming-aware/, not confirmed elsewhere. The subtitle names anxiety; the page describes mindfulness practice for calm with no treatment claim, so it passes the new rule.
